observations: The page number «31» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature and no margin notes. It is the last page of the Latin text. L01-L06 end chapter 37 (pp. 29-30, JP2 0061-0062): the product of the difference of the two columns and the proportion is subtracted from the first ray when the first is greater and added when it is less.

L03-L06: the right rays: the opposite of the left sextile is the right trine, of the left quartile the right quartile, of the left trine the right sextile; note 2: the edition prints «exagonum» where C, O and N have «trigonum». Checked: 60 + 180 = 240 = 360 - 120, 90 + 180 = 270 = 360 - 90, 120 + 180 = 300 = 360 - 60; the reading of the manuscripts would put the right trine opposite the left trine as well as opposite the left sextile.

L07-L36: a second account of the projection of the rays («proiectio lucis stellarum»; C's «matrak elshoa» in note 6, maṭraḥ al-shuʿāʿ), in square brackets: the bracket opens before «Cum» (L07) and closes after «infirmant.» (L36); note 15: O omits the passage, and N also omits its last sentence, L34-L36. Both brackets are of the ordinary weight. Note 3 gives the reading «XXX» for C and O, although L09 lies within the passage that note 15 says O omits; the other notes of the passage, 4-14, cite C and N only.

L13-L15: for the sextile the number at the head of the table for the sextile is added, for the trine the number at the head of the trine; for the quartile the text also has «quod est supra caput trigoni», where the procedure needs the number at the head of the quartile; the edition has no note on it. L25-L33: for an ascendant between two multiples of five degrees, the rays for both columns, and their difference in the proportion of the ascendant's excess over the lower multiple to five, as in L01-L03. L34-L36: for rumours the ascendant and its lord, the sign of the moon and its lord are considered; in fixed signs or not fixed ones they confirm or weaken the rumours.

The semicolons of the text and of the apparatus stand after the thin space of the edition (9-13 px measured; «O. ;» in N04, 11 px). N01 and N04: «Oppositum . . . . praetendit», «Pro . . . . infirmant», four points.
